# Registrations {#registrations .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Section 3
:::

::: notes
Section three is about the other thing that the OSF keeps: registrations, which freeze a plan with a date on it before the result is known. An archive freezes materials and a registration freezes a plan, and the two dates, of the plan and of the result, are what let a reader tell an analysis planned in advance from one chosen after the fact. We look at what a registration is and at one that did its job in a case of the course, then at the preregistration of Multi100 itself, and last at the two templates that a reanalysis can use.
:::
